in_sanskrit.name: सुभो
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Subho is derived from the Sanskrit word 'subh', which means good, auspicious, or fortunate. It is often used as a term of endearment or as a name for a newborn child, as it is believed to bring good luck and happiness to the family.

in_hindi.name: सुभो
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Subho in Hindi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'subh', which means good, auspicious, or fortunate. The Hindi term 'shubh' is synonymous with 'subh' and holds the same meaning. This name is often used as a term of endearment or as a name for a newborn child, as it is believed to bring good luck and happiness to the family.

in_tamil.name: சுப்போ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Subho in Tamil is derived from the Sanskrit word 'subh'. The Tamil term 'subbānam' is the translation of the Sanskrit term 'subh'. It means good, auspicious, or fortunate. This name is often used as a term of endearment or as a name for a newborn child, as it is believed to bring good luck and happiness to the family.

in_telugu.name: శుబ్హో
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Subho in Telugu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'subh'. The Telugu term 'subha' is the translation of the Sanskrit term 'subh'. It means good, auspicious, or fortunate. This name is often used as a term of endearment or as a name for a newborn child, as it is believed to bring good luck and happiness to the family.
